class.name: MetaHumanDNA
class.brief_description: The behavior layers of a MetaHuman DNA file.
class.description: The behavior layers of a MetaHuman DNA file: definitions, controls, joint behavior and correctives, without the geometry (the importer bakes that into meshes). [MetaHumanRig] evaluates it. RigLogic compiles the rig the first time it is needed and every [MetaHumanRig] using this resource shares that.

method.name: get_animated_map_names
method.description: Returns the names of the rig's animated maps (the wrinkle-map channels).

method.name: get_gui_control_names
method.description: Returns the names of the rig's face board controls.

method.name: get_joint_count
method.description: Returns the number of joints in the rig.

method.name: get_joint_name
method.description: Returns the name of joint [param joint].

method.name: get_lod_count
method.description: Returns the number of LODs in the rig.

method.name: get_raw_control_names
method.description: Returns the names of the rig's raw controls, driver inputs included.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [member data] holds a DNA rig that RigLogic accepts.

method.name: strip_geometry
method.description: Returns a DNA file holding only the layers a rig needs at run time, from the bytes of a full one. Returns an empty array if [param full_dna] cannot be read.

members.member: The DNA file's bytes, as [method strip_geometry] returns them.
